name: print-social-green-glow-launch-flyer-option-one-with-label-chips
title: Launch Flyer Option One with Label Chips
whatItIs: A presentation of a launch flyer on neon green: a dark teal flyer with grain and bokeh, a heavy 'Creatify' wordmark with an 8 as the letter, a red Launch tag, coloured label chips (Innovation, Connection, Celebration) and event details, with a second option peeking in at the right.
whatItMeans: Colourful label chips make a list playful and readable, and the number-as-letter adds personality.
techniques: Number 8 replacing a letter in the wordmark
Coloured label chips highlighting key words
Grainy dark teal with soft bokeh lights
Details row with icons for place, date and time
Option presentation on a bright contrasting green

vocabulary.definition: A coloured rectangle behind a word for emphasis.
One of several alternative layouts presented to a client.
